name: Destini Berhad
overview: 2026年，Destini Berhad 在 Mobility 板块签署了两项谅解备忘录：子公司 M Rail Technics 与 Siemens Mobility 合作探索建立可靠性控制中心（RCC）用于数据驱动的 MRO 项目；子公司 Destini Mobility 与 Zhejiang CRRC Electric Vehicle 合作探索马来西亚公共交通领域的电动巴士机会。此外，公司与 National Defence University of Malaysia 的谅解备忘录于2026年9月14日到期后不再续期。
overview_en: In 2026, Destini Berhad signed two memoranda of understanding in its Mobility segment: subsidiary M Rail Technics with Siemens Mobility to explore establishing a Reliability Control Centre (RCC) for data-driven MRO, and subsidiary Destini Mobility with Zhejiang CRRC Electric Vehicle for electric bus opportunities in Malaysia's public transportation sector. Separately, the company's MOU with National Defence University of Malaysia was not extended and expired on 14 September 2026.

segments.name: Mobility
segments.note: 今年在铁路 MRO 和电动巴士领域分别签署合作谅解备忘录，探索新项目机会。
segments.note_en: This year, the segment signed cooperation MOUs in rail MRO and electric buses to explore new project opportunities.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 公告 M Rail Technics 与 Siemens Mobility 的谅解备忘录截至2026年11月24日无重大进展。
actions.text_en: Announced that there was no material development as of 24 November 2026 on the MOU between M Rail Technics and Siemens Mobility.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 公告 Destini Mobility 与 Zhejiang CRRC Electric Vehicle 的谅解备忘录截至2026年11月24日无重大进展。
actions.text_en: Announced that there was no material development as of 24 November 2026 on the MOU between Destini Mobility and Zhejiang CRRC Electric Vehicle.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 70%持股子公司 M Rail Technics 与 Siemens Mobility 签署谅解备忘录，探索建立可靠性控制中心（RCC）用于数据驱动 MRO 项目的战略合作。
actions.text_en: 70%-owned subsidiary M Rail Technics signed an MOU with Siemens Mobility to explore strategic cooperation in establishing a Reliability Control Centre (RCC) for a data-driven MRO project.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 公告 Destini Mobility 与 Zhejiang CRRC Electric Vehicle 的谅解备忘录截至2026年8月28日无重大进展。
actions.text_en: Announced that there was no material development as of 28 August 2026 on the MOU between Destini Mobility and Zhejiang CRRC Electric Vehicle.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 全资子公司 Destini Mobility 与 Zhejiang CRRC Electric Vehicle 签署谅解备忘录，合作探索马来西亚公共交通领域的电动巴士机会。
actions.text_en: Wholly owned subsidiary Destini Mobility signed an MOU with Zhejiang CRRC Electric Vehicle to explore electric bus opportunities in Malaysia's public transportation sector.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年与 National Defence University of Malaysia 的谅解备忘录到期后不再续期。
segments.note_en: This year, the MOU with National Defence University of Malaysia was allowed to expire without extension.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 与 National Defence University of Malaysia 的谅解备忘录于2026年9月14日到期，公司决定不续期，该备忘录到期后失效。
actions.text_en: The MOU with National Defence University of Malaysia expired on 14 September 2026; the company decided not to extend it, and the MOU ceased to have effect upon expiry.

actions.text_en: Announced that there was no material development as of 26 May 2026 on the MOU with National Defence University of Malaysia.
